  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
 THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS -

  SUBJECT : CSE 2154 - OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING

1B)         Demonstrate the use of continue and break statement with an example program.

1C)         Define two classes A and B each having one String private data member. Write zero  
  argument and parameterized constructors to initialize the data member and member  
  functions to get, set and display the data member for these classes. In the demo class,  
  write a concat( ) function which takes the 2 arguments as class A and class B objects and  
  concatenates the data members of these two objects. Write main method that creates        (4)  
  instances of the classes A and B, assigns values to each and concatenates the value of  
  data member of these objects using the concat( ) function. Display the objects before  
  and after concatenation.  
  
2A)         Create a class Shape with a method void area().Extend this class Shape to three more      (5)  
  classes Rectangle, Triangle and Circle and override the method area() to compute the  
  area of specific shape. Design a Bounded Generic class called BoundGen, which is  
  bounded to Shape class and create a suitable constructor to instantiate object of any sub  
  class of Shape and a print() method which will print area of a specific Shape. Refer the  
  given code Snippet for your reference.  
  Sample Code Snippet.  
  class Test{  
  public static void main(String args[]){  
  $$BoundedGen< Shape> bobj=new BoundedGen< >(new Shape());$$  
  bobj.print();//prints area of Shape  
  $$BoundedGen< Shape> sobj=new BoundedGen< >(new Triangle(2,3));$$  
  sobj.print();//prints the area of Triangle  
  $$BoundedGen< Triangle> tobj=new BoundedGen< >(new Triangle(2,3));$$  
  tobj.print();//prints the area of Triangle

$$BoundedGen< Rectangle> robj=new BoundedGen< >(new Rectangle(2,3));$$  
  robj.print();//Prints the area of Rectangle  
  }}  
  
2B)   Illustrate the restrictions while using generics in Java?  
  (3)  
  
2C)   Illustrate with Non-compliant and compliant code snippets any two rules of Numeric  
  types and Operations with respect to Java CERT.                                           (2)  
  
3A)   An organization pays its employees on a weekly basis. The employees are of three  
  types: i) Salaried employees are paid a fixed weekly salary regardless of the number of  
  hours worked, ii) hourly employees are paid by the hour and receive overtime pay (i.e.,  
  1.5 times their hourly salary rate) for all hours worked more than 40 hours, iii)  
  commission employees are paid a percentage of their sales.                                (5)  
  Design a class hierarchy with a parent class Employee having a private instance  
  variable Name, include constructors in each class and two methods, one to print the  
  employee name and the other to compute the salary. Write a test class to show all the  
  functionalities. Use dynamic method dispatch.  
  
3B)   Create a package testpkg consisting of two classes A and B, class A being public should  
  have three variables, three methods (each variable and method of different access  
  specifier: default, public and protected) and a member interface consisting of two  
  methods. Class B being default should have a single method. Name this program as        (3)  
  A.java.  
  Write a Java program to compile and execute the package testpkg using fully qualified  
  name.  
  
3C)   Summarize the restrictions on the members of an interface. Demonstrate "group of  
  constants that will be used by many classes" with an example code.                        (2)  
  
4A)   What is Synchronization? Explain different ways of achieving synchronization in Java  
  Multithreading?                                                                           (2)  
  
4B)   Design an Interface BookTicket with an instance variable seatsavailable, and a method  
  void reserveTkt(int numberofseats) and CancelTkt(int numberofseats ). Implement the  
  methods in a class AdvBooking. Analyse the above scenario with a minimum of Three         (3)  
  Threads, where two threads is trying to reverse a seat and another thread is trying to  
  cancel the reserved tickets.  
  
4C)   Create a javafx application to prebook a car order in advance as shown in the given  
  Figure. Write the complete program with import statements Analyse the code for proper  
  inputs.  
  
  
  (5)

SA) Write a JavaFX application program to display a circle and square using a canvas.  
Provide a combo box that contains options to draw square and circle shapes. Set the title  
of the application to Shapes. Upon the press of a button called Change Color, the (4)  
displayed shapes should change their fill in the order of red, green, blue, yellow and  
repeat indefinitely.
